ApplyOfficial application page ↗

EMCL is a two-year research master in clinical linguistics, neurolinguistics and psycholinguistics run by the universities of Eastern Finland, Ghent and Groningen. The application portal for the 2027-2029 intake opened on 1 October 2026 and closes on 1 December 2026, so this is one of the tightest Mundus windows this season.

Programme Highlights

  • Research-heavy programme that funds and prepares students for PhD entry
  • 24-month, 120-ECTS joint degree across three universities
  • Two-month application window: 1 October – 1 December 2026
  • Alumni in neurotechnology, clinical research and academic linguistics

Who Should Apply

Applicants typically hold a bachelor's in linguistics, speech therapy, psychology or cognitive science with strong research promise; the consortium is explicit that it funds and prepares talented, motivated students for doctoral work.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships covering tuition and living costs for selected research-track students.

Deadline and How to Apply

Use the application form on the EMCL site and submit by 1 December 2026; non-EU applicants should also review Finland's residence-permit logistics early. Key deadline information: 1 December 2026; application portal open 1 October – 1 December 2026 (intake 2027-2029).

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EMCL Consortium (University of Groningen)

The EMCL consortium delivers the European Master in Clinical Linguistics as an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master, coordinated from Groningen with Ghent University and the University of Eastern Finland plus two dozen associated clinical and research partners.

Official website: https://www.emcl.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
